entries.title: Read-aloud access published across Blogs & Essays
entries.summary: The public Blogs & Essays reading copies now provide browser-based narration with selectable device voices, adjustable speaking speed, play, pause, resume, stop, progress, and accessible status controls. Narration is limited to the authored text and does not retain reader activity or require an external speech service.
entries.sourceLabel: Utopian Society Corpus v2 read-aloud release
